query:
SELECT i.id AS "id: InboxId" FROM conversations.inboxes i
                    WHERE i.detached_at IS NULL
                      AND (i.owner = $1
                           OR (i.owner IS NULL AND EXISTS (
                                 SELECT 1 FROM conversations.inbox_members me
                                  WHERE me.inbox_id = i.id AND me.user_id = $1)))
                    ORDER BY i.id
                      FOR SHARE OF i
